Method of Attack: Typosquatting leading to accidental installation due to npm command line flag misuse or typographical errors
Package name mimics npm command line flags causing it to be pulled in unintentionally
Impacted Systems: npm package ecosystems where '-' is pulled in as dependency
Attack Vector: Typographical errors in npm install commands or package.json dependencies causing accidental installation
Use of '-' as a package name that is valid per npm naming rules but can be mistakenly installed
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of '-' package in package-lock.json and node_modules folder
High download counts (~720,000) despite no functional code
README.md and npm page indicating package generated by script
npm install commands with extra '-' flag causing package to be installed
